paper.title: Quantum error correction below the surface code threshold

result.summary: 本文在超导量子处理器上实现了低于阈值的表面码量子纠错。作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-5表面码并集成实时解码器 [S1.p3]。距离-7逻辑量子比特的每周期逻辑错误率为0.143%±0.003%，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02，其寿命超过最佳组成物理量子比特寿命的2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p5][S2.p7]。作者还通过距离-29重复码探测到约每小时出现一次的关联错误事件，形成约10^-10的错误下限 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。这些结果表明，若可扩展，该器件性能有望满足大规模容错量子算法的运行需求 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是实现并验证表面码在物理错误率低于临界阈值时的运行，从而获得随码距增加而指数抑制的逻辑错误率 [S1.p1]。原文指出，尽管许多平台展示了量子纠错的不同特征，但尚无量子处理器明确展示低于阈值的性能 [S1.p1]。此外，容错量子计算还要求处理器在数小时时间尺度上保持稳定，并实时解码综合征信息 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
These include features like stability over the hours-long timescales of quantum algorithms and the active removal of correlated error sources like leakage.
the syndrome information produced by the quantum device must be decoded as fast as it is generated.

method.text: 作者在105量子比特处理器上实现距离-7表面码，在72量子比特处理器上实现距离-5表面码，并采用数据量子比特泄漏移除（DQLR）来抑制泄漏 [S2.p3][S3.p4]。解码方面使用神经网络解码器和集成匹配合成解码器，并通过处理器数据微调神经网络、用强化学习优化匹配图权重 [S2.p2]。作者还实现了基于Sparse Blossom的实时解码系统，采用分块并行化和常数大小图缓冲区 [S5.p2]。

evidence.quote: We operate a distance-7 surface code memory comprising 49 data qubits, 48 measure qubits, and 4 additional leakage removal qubits
One is a neural network decoder, and the other is a harmonized ensemble of correlated minimum-weight perfect matching decoders augmented with matching synthesis.
we fine-tune the neural network with processor data and apply a reinforcement learning optimization to the matching graph weights.
We employ a specialized version of the Sparse Blossom algorithm optimized to quickly resolve local configurations of errors common in surface code decoding
The decoder operates on a constant-sized graph buffer

experiments.text: 作者在105量子比特处理器上运行距离-3、-5、-7表面码存储实验，最多250个纠错周期，每个数据点10^5次重复 [S2.p5]。在72量子比特处理器上运行距离-29重复码，1000个纠错周期、2×10^7次采样，共2×10^10个纠错周期、5.5小时处理器执行时间 [S4.p2]。作者还进行了错误注入实验、泄漏移除对比实验、15小时内16次重复的稳定性测试，以及距离-5表面码最多10^6周期的实时解码实验 [S3.p1][S3.p4][S3.p5][S5.p3]。

evidence.quote: We characterize our surface code logical performance by fitting the logical error per cycle $\varepsilon_{d}$ up to 250 cycles
we run a distance-29 repetition code for 1000 cycles of error correction over $2\times 10^{7}$ shots
In total, we execute $2\times 10^{10}$ cycles of error correction comprising 5.5 hours of processor execution time.
we measure logical performance of one distance-5 and four distance-3 codes 16 times over 15 hours
For our distance-5 surface code, we test different problem sizes by increasing the number of error correction cycles up to $10^{6}$.

findings.text: 距离-7表面码的每周期逻辑错误率为(1.43±0.03)×10^-3，错误抑制因子Λ=2.14±0.02 [S2.p5]。距离-7逻辑量子比特寿命为291±6 µs，超过所有组成物理量子比特寿命（中位数85±7 µs，最佳119±13 µs）的2.4±0.3倍 [S2.p7]。实时解码下距离-5表面码仍保持低于阈值性能，Λ=2.0±0.1，平均解码延迟63±17 µs，且不随实验长度增加 [S5.p3][S5.p4]。距离-29重复码在d=5到11之间Λ=8.4±0.1，但在d≥15时出现约10^-10的逻辑错误下限，由约每小时一次的关联错误爆发导致 [S4.p3][S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$
The distance-7 logical qubit lifetime is $291\pm 6$ µs, exceeding the lifetimes of all the constituent physical qubits (median $85\pm 7$ µs, best $119\pm 13$ µs) by a factor of $2.4\pm 0.3$.
Our real-time decoder achieves $\varepsilon_{5}=0.35\%\pm 0.01\%$ and $\Lambda=2.0\pm 0.1$
We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment
we obtain an error suppression factor $\Lambda=8.4\pm 0.1$ when fitting logical error per cycle versus code distance between $d=5$ and 11
at code distances $d\geq 15$, we observe a deviation from exponential error suppression at high distances culminating in an apparent logical error floor of $10^{-10}$.
They occur approximately once an hour, rather than once every few seconds

limitations.text: 作者指出，距离-29重复码中约每小时一次的关联错误爆发成因尚不清楚，其导致的约10^-10错误下限将阻碍未来运行纠错算法 [S4.p4][S4.p1]。作者还指出，即使原则上可通过扩大当前处理器实现低逻辑错误率，实际资源消耗巨大，例如达到10^-6错误率需要距离-27逻辑量子比特、1457个物理量子比特 [S6.p3]。此外，扩大规模还会给实时解码带来额外挑战，因为每周期综合征测量数随码距二次增长 [S6.p3]。

evidence.quote: We do not yet understand the cause of these events, but mitigating them remains vital to building a fault-tolerant quantum computer.
Such errors would block our ability to run error-corrected algorithms in the future
achieving a $10^{-6}$ error rate would require a distance-27 logical qubit using 1457 physical qubits.
Scaling up will also bring additional challenges in real-time decoding as the syndrome measurements per cycle increase quadratically with code distance.
